# Setup
```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(anndata)
library(stringr)
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)

root.dir <- "/Users/pengja/PennNeurosurgery Dropbox/Jackie Peng/SilverbushLab/Projects/Jackie_post-mortem/"
```



# Create Seurat Object
```{r}
ad <- read_h5ad(paste0(root.dir, "ExternalData/", "Wang_2022_longitudinal_GBM/", "from_wang_2023_reanalysis/", "SCSP0000480.h5ad"))

counts <- as.matrix(ad$X)
counts <- t(counts)
seurat.obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts)

# add metadata
obs.df <- ad$obs
obs.df$cell.barcode <- rownames(obs.df)
obs.df$individual <- sapply(obs.df$cell.barcode, function(x) unlist(str_split(x, "_"))[1])
obs.df$cell_type <- as.character(obs.df$cell_type)
print(unique(obs.df$cell_type))

# add sample-level metadata from supplemental table of original paper
sample.metadata.df <- read_excel(paste0(root.dir, "ExternalData/", "Wang_2022_longitudinal_GBM/", "43018_2022_475_MOESM2_ESM.xlsx"), sheet = 2)
sample.metadata.df <- sample.metadata.df %>% dplyr::filter(`snRNA-seq` == "Y")

all.obs.df <- left_join(obs.df, sample.metadata.df, by = c("individual" = "ID"))

seurat.obj <- AddMetaData(seurat.obj, all.obs.df)

seurat.obj <- NormalizeData(seurat.obj)

# percent mitochondrial genes
seurat.obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat.obj, pattern = "^MT-")

saveRDS(seurat.obj, paste0(root.dir, "ProcessedData/", "Wang_2022_logitudinal_GBM/", "seurat_objects/", "wang.2022.longitudinal.GBM.seurat.obj.RDS"))
```
